{"command":"cd /work && cat todo/api.py && cat >> tests/test_api.py <<'EOF'


def test_create_with_priority_and_reload(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "high"})
    assert t["priority"] == "high"
    assert create_task(s, {"title": "b"})["priority"] == "normal"
    s2 = Store(p)
    assert [t["priority"] for t in list_tasks(s2)] == ["high", "normal"]


def test_create_unknown_priority_not_saved(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "urgent"})
    assert list_tasks(s) == []
    s2 = Store(p)
    assert list_tasks(s2) == []


def test_update_priority_validation(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    assert update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "low"})["priority"] == "low"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "bogus"})
    # unchanged after failed update
    assert Store(p).tasks[t["id"]].priority == "low"


def test_legacy_store_loads_as_normal(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    import json
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"version": 1, "tasks": [{"id": 1, "title": "old", "done": False}]}, f)
    s = Store(p)
    assert list_tasks(s) == [{"id": 1, "title": "old", "done": False, "priority": "normal"}]


def test_list_filter_and_sort(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "low"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "b", "priority": "high"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "c", "priority": "normal"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "d", "priority": "high"})
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s, priority="high")] == ["b", "d"]
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s, sort="priority")] == ["b", "d", "c", "a"]
    assert [t["title"] for t in list_tasks(s)] == ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
    import pytest as _; _.raises(ValueError, lambda: list_tasks(s, priority="bogus"))
EOF
